E1265

`core.crypto.vault.get` can't be reached from a build-time context.

What

`core.crypto.vault.get` can't be reached from a build-time context.

Why

Module-field and comptime evaluation run before secrets are decrypted. A repository opens its encrypted store only at ordinary runtime, such as inside a `-[Secret]>` function. There is no audited gate escape because a build artifact must never contain a decrypted secret.

Fix

Move the secret read out of comptime or module-field evaluation and into ordinary runtime code.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1265: tests/ui/secret_in_build.stderr.

Error [jet.SecretAtBuildTime]: `core.crypto.vault.get()` can't be reached from a build-time context
  --> tests/ui/secret_in_build.jet:4:21
    |
  4 |     cfg: #run vault.get("db_password")
    |                     ^^^
